_kg_snapshots_dir: the released KG snapshots the labels refer to (kg_snapshot_<year>-01-01.tsv.gz)
_entity_dicts_dir: the released per-snapshot entity dictionaries (<year>-01-01/documents.jsonl.gz); an entity is in the KG if it is in a snapshot triple OR in this dictionary. Every TKGU operation must agree with the KG (src/dataset/emerge/tkgu_rules.py)
